# Cursor BYOK v1.0.4

## 更新内容

- 新增 Gemini 原生请求格式，支持获取模型列表、流式输出和工具调用，使用 Google 官方 Gemini 图标。
- 按模型配置请求格式、完整请求 URL 和额外参数。同一供应商下可混用不同请求格式，升级时自动迁移已有模型配置。
- 支持以美元、人民币、欧元、日元、新台币、土耳其里拉和韩元显示费用。汇率支持每 24 小时自动同步、立即同步和手动设置，原始费用及模型单价仍以美元记录。
- 区分缓存用量未上报和明确为零。近期调用样本满足条件时，按可配置比例估算缓存读取，默认 90%，费用明细会注明估算依据。总览明细新增缓存命中率。
- 侧栏可折叠并记住状态。调用表前置状态、调用序号和模型名，增强更新行高亮，保留总览调用表的滚动位置。缺少实测生成速度时，可用的端到端速度以 `≈` 标示。

## Changes

- Add the native Gemini request format with model discovery, streaming, tool calling, and the official Google Gemini icon.
- Configure the request format, full request URL, and additional parameters per model. Models under one provider can use different formats, and existing settings migrate on upgrade.
- Display costs in USD, CNY, EUR, JPY, TWD, TRY, or KRW. Exchange rates can sync every 24 hours, refresh on demand, or be set manually. Stored costs and model prices remain in USD.
- Distinguish unreported cache usage from an explicit zero. When recent calls provide enough evidence, estimate cache reads using a configurable rate that defaults to 90%, and label the estimate in cost details. Show cache hit rates in overview breakdowns.
- Collapse the sidebar and remember its state. Bring status, call index, and model name to the front of the call table, highlight updated rows, and retain the overview table's scroll position. When generation speed is unavailable, show the available end-to-end speed with an `≈` marker.
